story.title: Zombification
story.blurb: Twelve-year-old Squemfet gets a temporary permit to leave Vortox-56 and follows his author father to a foggy burial ground on Vortox-35.

lines.text: It was five in the morning when Squemfet was startled in his sleep. The sound of the obnoxiously loud shower had awoken him at the best part of his dream: when he had saved the Priest's daughter from the Llama and he was about to receive his nibble. No matter. A twelve-year-old goat will always have his imagination. As he jumped out of bed, he strode slowly towards the source of his awakening. Who could be showering so early in the morning?
"Ah, an adventure to be had--Oh! You're awake!" Squemfet's father made sure his towel was tightened and picked up his son. It was easy to do so--their height difference was about one to two feet.

lines.text: The kid put on a faded and green long-sleeved shirt and some cargo shorts. Whilst doing so, he looked at his Worship Doll. It was looking a little funny, with its horns resting on the dresser and its feet in the air. Although he didn't think much of it, such a sign could have been considered bad luck. He took a pocket knife as well, just in case he needed to cut anything.
"Are you ready, Squon?" His father was clad in some hunting attire, holding a high caliber laser pistol in his hand in a submissive manner. He handed it to his son without hesitation.

lines.text: A two-hour trip to the Travel Sector by Hypercarriage later, the small goat leaped out eagerly, yet clumsily. He and his father were guided to customs, who accepted their documentation. The customs officer made sure to warn them of the possible dangers ahead, and they were off. Via Intersystem Pod Travel, the two Squoatlings traveled to Vortox-35.
"You see, squon, the reason why I brought you here was to show you my inspiration. My oyster. My demi-Squoat." The kid's father was ecstatic about being here, but Squemfet was not as pleased.

lines.text: After exiting the pod and getting adjusted to the reduced gravity, the two trailed off into the unknown. A soft and quiet night awaited them, complete with silhouetted trees and a single planetary body in the sky opposing them. Squemfet's father took out a notepad and some chalk, starting to record his surroundings.
"Is this how you start your astounding books?" His dad was a highly acclaimed author in the Squoatling community.

segments.speaker: Emmett Tawfeek

lines.text: "Indeed. Sometimes I have to tone it down out of fear of the Squingling though. He's a pain in the ass sometimes." The Squingling was the head priest of the Squoatox religion. He had full control over everything that went on in Vortox-56, along with his band of parliament.

lines.text: In the patches of dirt before each tomb, appendages arose from the ground. At first, a hoof. Second, an arm. Then a torso, head, legs, and soon, an entire Squoatling body of rotting flesh and fur. The beings surrounded Squemfet and his father with hostility. The father held his son with an arm and took out his plasma revolver. Sounds of the future now occurred as the father strove to protect his son from these undead beings. Squemfet, wanting to help, squirmed out of his father's grasp. He fumbled with his laser pistol and shot, failing to hit anything. His father noticed a monster behind his son and shot. But he was too late.

Squemfet, out of a sudden state of adrenaline, uppercutted the zombie off his ear and headbutted it, nearly knocking its head off. He was panting. His fur was darkening, and he was bleeding badly from his ear. But before Squemfet endured any further Crave-induced changes, his father stuck a syringe in his neck, rendering him unconscious. The father took his son out of the field and more importantly, out of the misty barrier.

All Squemfet remembered for the rest of his day was when he woke up in bed at night. He had tubes hooked up to his neck, along with a heavily bandaged left ear. The kid didn't know what he got into on that planet. But he promised himself not to be so horrible of a shot in the future. He promised himself that he would ask for target practice. He also promised that he would never leave his father again in his own time of need.
